name: Ringo Vinda
description: Ringo Vinda was a planet found in the Ringo Vinda system, within the Eucer sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim. An important industrial production center, it was encircled by a massive space station that served as a distribution point for all incoming and outgoing resources.
